newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X, Minorca up on Busang hopes.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X, Minorca up on Busang hopes.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Minorca Resources dominated trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Thursday morning as pieces of the Busang gold puzzle fell into place.

Bre-X gained C$0.90 with almost three million shares changing hands in the first two hours of trading. Minorca was up almost 14 percent, rising C$0.75 to C$6.15 in trading of 1.2 million shares. The two companies topped the most-actives list for the TSE.
The gains come a day after Bre-X officials addressed analysts in a conference call about their Indonesian gold.
"The conference call yesterday provided the ammunition to a lot of people to hang on," said one analyst. "Things seem more positive now."

Bre-X shares took a dive to C$20.80 on Tuesday from C$23 on Monday, after the company announced a deal with Freeport-McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc of Louisiana and Bre-X's Indonesian partners.The deal leaves Bre-X with 45 percent of the huge Busang deposit, down from 90 percent, and the company is not being compensated for its former interest.
But in a conference call on Wednesday, Bre-X officials held out hope for a massive increase in the size of Busang.

The latest resource estimate for Busang put the deposit at 71 million ounces. But Bre-X's vice-president of exploration, John Felderhof, said the next estimate, expected in mid-April, would put the resource at about 95 million ounces.
"If you would ask me what is the total potential, I would feel very comfortable with 200 million ounces," Felderhof said.
While Felderhof's comments were dismissed by some analysts as "off the cuff" and highly prospective, they did fuel hopes that the size of the deposit would expand further.
"John Felderhof has always been right," said gold analyst Michael Fowler with Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion.
Production costs will likely be lower than the US$96 an ounce predicted in previous studies and production rates will probably be higher, Felderhof said.

Even if Felderhof's predictions are considered preliminary and speculative, "the numbers are of such magnitude that people are getting very excited," said gold analyst Marc Cohen of PaineWebber in New York. The deposit's potential helps make up for Bre-X's lack of compensation in the Freeport deal.
Bre-X will likely become a takeover candidate later this spring once the Indonesian government grants the company its contracts of work for Busang, analysts said.

As for Minorca, analysts said investors are placing more faith in the small company's arrangement with PT Asktatindo Karya Minerals, an Indonesian company that now owns 30 percent of Busang in conjunction with PT Amsya Lyna, another Indonesian company.
Minorca has an agreement giving it a seven percent stake in Busang, but the size of the stake could grow, Minorca said on Thursday.
"We feel very positve about the potential to raise our interest," spokeswoman Danielle Goldberg said.
